title: Lead Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Lead Concept Artist to help us continue shaping the future of Fortnite. We are searching for an experienced artist to support and supervise creative content provided by artists. Reporting to the individual art team director and working with the Outsource Manager, the Lead Concept Artist will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Epic review. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, we are looking for an experienced Concept Artist with a solid hands-on art background who has worked in game studio pipelines before. The ideal candidate would be a talented artist who is able to communicate with artists, including documenting existing pipelines, collecting or creating quality bar and technical example assets, collecting photo references, creating mood boards, creating paint overs, and finally collaborating with other teams at Epic to ensure that concept art is of the highest quality and adequately supports the needs of those teams and the project.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the individual Art Leads, Art Directors, and Outsource Manager(s) on the team to support internal artists
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the artists
  • If required, make any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready
  • Clearly communicate feedback to the artists, and ensure those creative notes and goals are met, and inform leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicate and partner with internal Epic art staff to ensure that concept art is clear and respects limitations from other disciplines
  • When required, some amount of hands-on art production to deliver concepts for the project, ensuring they are familiar and capable working alongside other Epic artists

What we're looking for

  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior/Lead Concept Artist role
  • Experience working with intellectual properties
  • A portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity, and craftsmanship
  • Effective communicator, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate between internal and external teams and deliver clear and concise feedback
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Understanding of other game art disciplines, their workflows, and limitations (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
  • A PLUS - Fluency in a language other than English, including Chinese, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russian

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

description:

Todas as vagas da Arco são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Estamos em busca de talentos para atuar em nosso time financeiro!

Se você busca desafios em um ambiente dinâmico e quer contribuir com o crescimento estratégico da empresa, essa é a sua chance. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e impulsionar sua carreira!

Envie seu currículo e faça parte dessa jornada!

Para quais áreas você pode se candidatar:

Administrativo/Viagens: A Magia de Organizar o Mundo!

Nosso time de Viagens vai além da logística e dos relatórios de viagem — somos mestres na arte de conectar pessoas, destinos e oportunidades de forma eficiente. Como analista, você será responsável por nossas plataformas de viagens, gerenciar acessos e garantir que todos os detalhes estejam perfeitamente alinhados. Se você é uma pessoa organizada, apaixonada por otimização e adora planejar tudo nos mínimos detalhes, este é o seu lugar!


Contabilidade: A Arte de Contar Histórias com Números!

Para além dos balanços e demonstrações financeiras — somos contadores de histórias através de números. Aqui você irá analisar dados, elaborar relatórios e garantir que as finanças da empresa estejam sempre em dia. Se você é detalhista e adora resolver quebra-cabeças, este é o seu lugar!


Compras: A Estratégia de Encontrar Oportunidades no Mercado!

Nossa equipe de Compras vai além de negociar e adquirir produtos — somos especialistas em identificar as melhores oportunidades de mercado e garantir que a empresa tenha tudo o que precisa para operar com excelência. Aqui você será responsável por negociar com fornecedores, analisar custos e garantir que os processos de aquisição sejam ágeis e eficientes. Se você é uma pessoa estratégica, com visão analítica e gosta de encontrar soluções vantajosas, este é o seu lugar!


Contas a Pagar: A Responsabilidade de Garantir a Saúde Financeira!

Além de processar pagamentos — somos responsáveis por manter o fluxo financeiro da empresa sempre em dia, garantindo que todos os compromissos sejam cumpridos com precisão e no prazo. Aqui você será responsável por gerenciar faturas, controlar vencimentos e assegurar que as transações sejam realizadas de forma eficiente. Se você é organizado, detalhista e possui forte senso de responsabilidade, este é o seu lugar!


Controladoria: O Coração da Governança Financeira!

Somos os guardiões da precisão e da integridade financeira da empresa. Aqui você vai mergulhar em processos de controle, auditoria e planejamento orçamentário, garantindo que cada decisão financeira seja tomada com confiança e responsabilidade. Se você busca um ambiente de aprendizado sólido e desafiador, essa área é para você!


Controles Internos: Garantindo a Eficiência e Segurança dos Processos!

Nossa equipe vai além de monitorar processos — somos responsáveis por assegurar que as operações da empresa aconteçam de forma eficiente, transparente e segura, minimizando riscos e garantindo a conformidade. Aqui você irá avaliar e melhorar os controles existentes, realizando auditorias e propondo soluções para otimizar os processos. Se você é detalhista, analítico e gosta de garantir a integridade dos processos, este é o seu lugar!


Crédito e Cobrança: Contribuindo para o Sucesso Financeiro da Empresa!

Nosso objetivo é garantir a saúde financeira da empresa, mantendo um fluxo de caixa estável e eficiente. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de executar técnicas de negociação, gestão de crédito e relacionamento com clientes, sendo parte fundamental do nosso sucesso. Tem perfil comunicativo e gosta de desafios? Junte-se ao nosso time!


Fiscal/Tributário: Desvendando o Mundo dos Impostos!

Esse time é especialista em navegar pelo complexo universo da legislação fiscal. Aqui você irá atuar na otimização de carga tributária da empresa, analisar normas fiscais e colaborar em projetos de compliance. Se você tem afinidade com números e adora um bom desafio legal, essa área é a sua cara!


P&A (Planejamento Financeiro e Análise): Onde a Estratégia Financeira Ganha Vida!

No time de FP&A, você será parte essencial da construção de cenários e projeções que direcionam as decisões estratégicas da empresa. Aqui você mergulhará no universo das análises financeiras, ajudando a transformar dados em insights valiosos para o futuro do nosso negócio. Curioso e analítico? Venha com a gente!


Funding: Impulsionando o Crescimento da Empresa!

Nós captamos recursos e muito mais — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha o financiamento necessário para impulsionar seu crescimento e atingir seus objetivos estratégicos. Aqui você será responsável por identificar fontes de financiamento, negociar com investidores e acompanhar as condições de captação. Se você é estratégico, proativo e tem afinidade com o mercado financeiro, este é o seu lugar!


RGM (Revenue Growth Management): Estratégia para Maximizar o Crescimento da Receita!

Além de analisar dados financeiros — somos responsáveis por desenvolver estratégias que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável da receita, otimizando preços, promoções e a gestão de canais. Aqui você irá identificar oportunidades de crescimento, analisar tendências de mercado e garantir que as decisões comerciais estejam alinhadas com os objetivos financeiros da empresa. Se você é analítico, estratégico e tem visão para identificar oportunidades de maximizar a receita, este é o seu lugar!


M&A (Fusões e Aquisições): Ajudando a Construir o Futuro da Empresa!

Esse time está sempre em busca de novas oportunidades de crescimento. Aqui você vai avaliar investimentos, realizar due diligence, e participar de negociações que definem o rumo da empresa. É apaixonado por estratégia e mercados financeiros? Venha nos ajudar a construir o futuro!


Tesouraria: Gestão Eficiente do Fluxo de Caixa!

Somos feras em gerenciar os recursos financeiros — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha sempre o capital necessário para suas operações, além de planejar e controlar os fluxos de caixa, investimentos e financiamentos. Aqui você irá controlar a liquidez da empresa, monitorar contas bancárias e garantir que as operações financeiras aconteçam de maneira eficiente e segura. Se você é detalhista, tem visão estratégica e um forte controle financeiro, este é o seu lugar!

Para esses desafios você precisa:

  • Residir em uma de nossas cidades base (Curitiba, São Paulo, Fortaleza) ou ter disponibilidade para mudança;
  • Possuir experiência na área financeira.

Buscamos talentos que tenham:

  • Bons conhecimentos em ferramentas de dados como Excel e BI;
  • Capacidade de agir de forma autônoma e buscar soluções criativas para problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de construir pontes relacionais com diferentes áreas;
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados, elaborar relatórios e contribuir para a tomada de decisões;
  • Capacidade de lidar com mudanças e desafios em um ambiente corporativo, adaptando-se rapidamente aos novos cenários;

Diferenciais:

  • Inglês fluente obrigatório para a área de M&A;

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossaspessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e commais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos quetodas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #VemPraArco

title: Data Engineer Manager
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a talented and passionate Data Engineer – Generalist to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll leverage modern technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines while contributing to organizational best practices. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and have a knack for innovative problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Data Engineering team lead in ensuring quality and agility across team activities.
  • Collaborating with fellow data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using leading-edge technologies.
  • Building and maintaining data pipelines that integrate diverse data sources into a Harmonized Data Mesh for both internal and external use.
  • Debugging, unit testing, and deploying data pipelines while optimizing their performance.
  • Managing metadata associated with data and processes to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Documenting and versioning code to maintain transparency and scalability.
  • Promoting Data Engineering best practices and contributing to Enterprise Data Governance frameworks.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, high-quality engineering solutions that meet evolving business needs.
  • Driving continuous improvement in test development, automation, and release processes.
  • Advocating for user-centric design and functionality when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience:
  • Relevant experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms, preferably Azure.
  • Proficiency in modern data storage systems (e.g., Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse).
  • Expertise in developing data pipelines using PySpark, Scala, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience working with Big Data platforms, such as Databricks.
  • Advanced knowledge of relational/transactional databases and SQL.
  • Strong skills in performance tuning for PySpark and SQL workflows.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Skills:
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to diverse audiences.
  • Passion for innovation and collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset:
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Creative thinker who enjoys solving complex problems.
  • Team-oriented and adaptable to shifting priorities.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team shaping the future of data engineering in ABI.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A supportive culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing at TRACTIAN

Tractian is revolutionizing industrial asset management with advanced B2B SaaS solutions that drive operational reliability and efficiency. Our high-ticket focus requires a strategic and results-driven marketing approach to generate and capture qualified opportunities that translate into measurable revenue impact.

What will you do

As a Performance Specialist, your role is centered on driving lead generation and revenue through expert management of paid media campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), and related). You'll focus on meticulously crafting and optimizing campaigns across various channels, utilizing advanced targeting and data-driven strategies to enhance lead acquisition and conversion rates. Your expertise in A/B testing, ROI analysis, and budget management will be crucial in continually refining campaigns for maximum efficiency and profitability, directly contributing to the company's revenue growth.


Responsibilities
  • Develop, execute, and analyze comprehensive performance marketing strategies across various digital channels (Earned, Paid, and Owned), including Paid Search, Paid Social, Retargeting, Paid Influencers, Content Promotion, Display Ads, and related.
  • Plan, create, and optimize high-converting digital ad campaigns that align with business goals, utilizing A/B testing and data analysis to enhance conversion rate continuously.
  • Employ advanced targeting techniques to reach specific audience segments, leveraging customer data, demographics, and behavioral insights to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Manage advertising budgets effectively, monitor spending, and allocate resources to campaigns that deliver the best returns, ensuring ROI goals are met and exceeded.
  • Utilize analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance metrics such as click-through rates, conversion rates, CPA, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Collaborate closely with creative teams to develop compelling ad creatives, landing pages, and ad copy that drive engagement and conversions.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales teams to follow and collaborate to the Revenue Goals
  • Create, analyze, and interpret data to provide actionable insights and recommendations for improving campaign performance and overall marketing strategy.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other marketing teams, product teams, and data analysts to align performance marketing efforts with broader business objectives.
  • Develop and execute integrated cross-channel and omnichannel strategies, aligning digital and offline media for consistent brand engagement.
Requirements
  • 5+ years in Demand Generation or Performance Marketing within high-ticket B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of driving revenue and achieving pipeline goals.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Exceptional project management skills, capable of managing multiple campaigns, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in performance marketing, with a proven track record of planning and executing successful campaigns that deliver quantifiable results.
  • Advanced knowledge in utilizing performance marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Programmatic Ads, and other relevant tools.
  • Revenue Focus: Deep understanding of SQL conversion, CAC, ROI, and high-ticket sales cycles, ensuring alignment of marketing efforts with revenue objectives.

title: Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning
description:
Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning

AWS Game-Based Learning Products is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a fast-paced, startup-minded innovation team where fun is an integral part of your job. Joining our team, you will collaborate with a team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers responsible for the conception, development and operations of highly technical game-based learning solutions that rely on extensive use of hands-on labs, virtual environments, and interactive simulations to get customers to develop practical skills using AWS services.
As a Software Development Engineer, you will partner with fellow backend engineers to build cloud services platforms that are foundational to our games; you will collaborate with Unity3d engineers to create rich gameplays; you will cooperate with designers and artists to develop a compelling end-to-end visual gaming experience; and you will assist learning architects and instructional designers map learning objectives and game elements to deliver a unique cloud learning experience to our players.
For more information about some of our products:
- job responsibilities
- Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers to design, deliver, maintain, and operate multiple game-based learning products;
- Drive our system architecture and promote best practices to produce high quality games, and coach less tenured engineers;
- Partner with technical and business stakeholders to influence our long-term strategy and establish the team's roadmap;
- Make data-driven decisions by leveraging industry landscape from engineering, gaming and training, as well as user feedback and telemetry data;
- Write high quality code.
A day in the life
You will work with engineering and product stakeholders closely on a day-to-day basis. You will contribute to the production of multiple games and features and collaborate with other learning products teams (e.g.: AWS SkillBuilder, AWS Labs, AWS Jam, Exam Prep). You will solve, learn, and mentor team members on web-scale challenges, distributed systems problems, and game development best practices. You will regularly review technical work with peers, stakeholders, and leadership.
About the team
AWS Game-Based Learning team members are spread across the US, Canada, and Brazil. Our mission is to build learning products that use game thinking principles. We combine learning strategies with game technologies and theories to develop appealing knowledge transfer experiences that target customer needs.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese (verbal and written)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops)
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a skilled and versatile Tech Manager Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining innovative software solutions. You will work across various functions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with teams to design and develop features for global products that meet business and user needs.
  • Driving improvements in architecture, code quality, and overall development practices.
  • Actively engaging in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
  • Conducting design and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Partnering with colleagues to build and maintain tools for test development, automation, and release process improvements.
  • Advocating for user experience when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.
  • Coaching and mentoring team members to foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.
  • Debugging, testing, and optimizing code to enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Developing and maintaining scalable, data-driven applications with a focus on quality and reliability.

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience in software development, including server-side and backend development.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Java, C#, or similar.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) and DevOps tools like Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and database optimization (e.g., SQL Server, T-SQL).
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, XUnit) and automation tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
  • Proficiency in source control systems such as Git/GitHub.
  • Passionate about software development and continuously improving processes.
  • Motivated by building impactful solutions that reach millions of users.
  • Adaptable to dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
  • Creative thinker with a focus on collaboration and teamwork.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team that values creativity and diversity.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A culture that fosters professional growth, learning, and mentorship.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Firmware Quality Assurance Analyst

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Firmware QA Analyst, you will take on the crucial responsibility of ensuring the quality, functionality, and reliability of our firmware products. You’ll serve as the last line of defense, protecting our customers from potential headaches and ensuring they experience only the best our technology has to offer. In this role, you will not only test and validate firmware but also champion a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.   • Integrating Testing into CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborate with the development team to embed automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline, enabling frequent and reliable testing for continuous delivery of high-quality firmware.
  • Ensuring Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with QA and development teams to identify and address testing gaps, improving processes and ensuring timely, high-quality releases.
  • Driving Firmware Quality Improvements: Act as a key stakeholder in the firmware lifecycle, advocating for quality-first approaches and ensuring the final product meets customer expectations and industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

  • Familiarity with data acquisition, processing, and logging techniques for embedded testing purposes.

  • Experience with GitHub Actions, for CI/CD implementations.
  • Excellent analytical skills.

title: Global Workforce Planning Sr Analyst
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Global Workforce Planning Sr Analyst to join Wildlife's team. You will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed workforce decisions and ensuring accurate headcount planning, people cost modeling, and reporting for our global operations. Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining dashboards, analyzing workforce trends, and partnering with key stakeholders to optimize our workforce strategy.

You’ll work closely with HR, Finance, and other teams to improve, review, and implement processes related to workforce planning, reporting, and data accuracy.

The work we do has a high impact on our company's success, scalability, and strategic decision-making. The right person for this position is curious, analytical, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems with data, and can thrive in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

What you'll do

  • Workforce planning and headcount management: Develop, maintain, and optimize headcount plans in alignment with business goals, budget cycles, and hiring plans.
  • People cost analysis and reporting: Partner with Finance and HR to model people costs, including salaries, benefits, and other employee-related expenses across multiple countries.
  • Data-driven insights: Design and deliver dashboards and reports that provide visibility into workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, hiring trends, and cost forecasts.
  • Scenario modeling: Support strategic decision-making by running workforce scenarios (e.g., growth, restructuring, hiring freezes) and analyzing their impact on costs and capacity.
  • System integration and data governance: Ensure data integrity between HRIS, payroll, finance systems, and reporting tools, improving automation and data accuracy.
  • Business partnership: Act as a strategic partner to HR, Finance, and business leaders, providing actionable insights to drive workforce decisions.
  • Process improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, streamline data collection, and improve workforce planning accuracy.
  • Monitor trends and risks: Track global labor market trends, attrition risks, and internal workforce dynamics to inform proactive planning.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, HR, Economics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in workforce planning, payroll, or financial planning related to people costs.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker).
  • Solid understanding of HR systems (HRIS) and how they integrate with financial data.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

Nice to have

  • Understanding of global payroll and labor cost structures.
  • Previous experience in a fast-growing, multinational company.

More about you

  • You’re passionate about solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements;
  • You have a strategic mindset and enjoy developing programs that align with business goals.
  • You’re detail-oriented and have a knack for analyzing data to make informed decisions.
  • You’re a strong communicator and can clearly explain complex concepts to various stakeholders.
  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams.

We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for reviewing and optimizing technical proposals to ensure alignment with the company’s capabilities and technical requirements, supporting the proper field installation and system integration. You will manage the implementation process, including the integration of sensors, PLCs, and frequency inverters, ensuring that the solutions are robust, scalable, and meet client demands. Additionally, you will oversee the go-live phase, validate system functionality, and provide post-implementation technical support.


Responsibilities
  • Review and adjust technical proposals developed by the Sales team, ensuring they align with the company's capabilities and the required technical specifications, thereby supporting the technical implementation and correct field installation;
  • Verify the compatibility of system integrations (sensors, PLCs, Frequency Inverters, etc.) within the client’s environment, ensuring that the solutions are robust and scalable;
  • Participate in client meetings to better understand their demands and translate these needs into viable technical solutions;
  • Manage the implementation schedule, ensuring that the stages are completed within the established deadlines and that the system functions properly;
  • Supervise the application and go-live phase of the implemented systems, validating the correct functioning of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring systems;
  • Work closely with the Data Science, Hardware, and Platform teams to develop, optimize, and implement features that add value to the solutions;
  • Provide post-implementation technical support, helping to resolve technical issues or make adjustments when necessary;
  • Collaborate with other teams in the company, such as Technical Support and Product Engineering, to ensure that the developed solutions are aligned with the company's capabilities and innovations;
  • Help identify opportunities for upsell or additional improvements in projects, based on technical understanding and customer feedback.
Requirements
  • +5 Years of Industrial Experience, preferably with a background in Industrial Automation and Project Management;
  • Familiarity with handling and programming (Ladder Logic) various PLC brands (Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, etc.);
  • Experience with SCADA, DCS, or other supervisory and control systems;
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, or OPC UA for sensor and controller integration;
  • Experience with instrumentation and sensor sizing (level, pressure, flow, humidity, etc.);
  • Ability to work with measurement and control systems for electrical and mechanical variables;
  • Willingness to travel to client plants and ability to conduct technical demonstration meetings;
  • Managing technical projects (scope, implementation schedule, technical sizing, and structural review) alongside the Sales team;
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with exceptional ability to present solutions to complex problems.
Bonus Points
  • CMVP Certification;
  • PMP Certification;
  • Experience in asset monitoring;
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

Agente Stone - Consultor(a) Comercial Externo | Passo Fundo/RS

Passo Fundo, Rio Grande Do Sul, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta | 44h semanais.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e video aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Rota Teste: Nosso objetivo é que você vivencie a rotina proposta na vaga na prática, ou seja, você acompanhará um(a) dos(as) nossos(as) agentes durante a sua rota.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

• Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive model applied to industrial operations to join our growing team. As Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for driving the construction of models to solve business problems, communicate to the technical team, and assure the delivery matches business expectations. You will also be responsible for working with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

· Design, create, test and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization.

· Collaborate with business analyst and understand business problems to implement scalable and sustainable solutions.

· Design and structure reusable codebase

· Communicates the design, functioning and output of the analytical models/solutions developed

· Ensure timely analysis and testing for regular maintenance of solutions over time

· Communicate data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

· Proficient in data science, optimization, machine learning, Python, R, SQL, data analysis, analytical skills, teamwork, and communication skills.

· Develop business awareness of possible use cases and help them to understand the necessary concepts of data science and optimization to ensure better communication across functions.

Education/Experience

· Proficient in Python

· Strong foundations in math, analytics and computer science, knowledge of machine learning methods, statistical models, advanced data science programming

· Avoid greenhorn mistakes, avoid logical flaws in the models, revisits high-performing systems, write reusable code, builds resilient data pipelines in the cloud environment, and prepares immaculate data.

· Deep understanding of Database designs. Prior course work is a plus

· Creative & innovative thinking; demonstrating drive to solve problems.

· Act as a great team player and pitch new ideas, take responsibility to improve code quality and impact.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. title: Business Analytics Manager
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Analytics Manager to ourPartner Sales Operations team in São Paulo, Brazil .

Wellhub Partnerships team is looking for a Sales Operations Analytics Manager to partner with our Regional Sales Operations Leads across the Globe (Latam, US and Europe) and support commercial leaders and their teams to make more data driven decisions through excellence in business intelligence. This will be a highly collaborative global position working closely with Sales Operations, Analytics and Commercial leaders. The Sales Operations Analytics Manager will report to the Director of Sales Operations and has no direct reports. You will be responsible for scaling our analytical capabilities through dashboards and strategic models, ensuring consistency in our planning, forecasting and insights generation within the partnerships organization..

YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop analytical models to calculate OKR and variable compensation targets
  • Create scalable data visualizations to be used by the Sales Operations Leads as the basis for their analysis of results and forecasting;
  • Develop solutions for the commercial teams to track their results and variable compensation
  • Interact with partners stakeholders to understand requirements and business information for accuracy;
  • Coach business partners on how to utilize dashboards and make improvements increasing readability and usability;
  • Build relationships with the Analytics Team and effectively navigate the organization to collaboratively deliver on commitments;
  • Develop and manage a plan and work product independently and see it through end-to-end through completion with on-time delivery;
  • Communicate complex concepts to management, team members and non-technical audiences in a simple and easy to understand way.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • Experience working with data visualization such as tableau, looker, etc;
  • Create dashboards, models and scalable reporting to be consumer;
  • Previous experience in Business Intelligence/ Analytics;
  • Knowledge and experience of analytics tools (SQL, Advanced Excel);
  • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong data presentation and visualization skills;
  • Strong analysis and pattern recognition skills, as well as synthesis skills, to be able to streamline work;
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, strategist and accuracy-first mindset;
  • Passion for excellence and continuous improvement;
  • Strong execution and ability to drive work to completion;

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience working with data analysis, data visualization and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Technical Information:

About AB InBev:

AB InBev is the global beer leader and one of the top 5 consumer products companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, they are number one or two in many of the world's major beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

As a technological cell of our organization, we have a simple goal: to grow. To grow as people, as professionals, as a company. To achieve this, we use technology to create digital solutions that simplify our customers' lives, make their decisions smarter, and their businesses more profitable.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and lead a high-performance team of data analysts, being a technical reference, providing guidance, mentoring, and support for the analysis team.
  • Manage a team of approximately 5 to 10 resources, depending on project allocation.
  • Review to verify that best practices have been followed for high-quality products, recommend appropriate data sources, models, and methods that may apply to a specific use case, ensuring scalability and high reuse.
  • Work with product leaders, engineering, and commercial strategy to form a unified data-driven strategy.
  • Support the prioritization exercise in analysis requests for your team alongside stakeholders and DPMs (data product managers), based on business impact, level of effort, etc.
  • Actively balance team leadership efforts with practical development/coding of data products, metrics, and visualizations to drive business.
  • Drive the business strategy by providing insights into current performance and highlighting areas of opportunity for growth. To do this, conduct advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models to answer specific business questions, extract insights and predictive patterns from large datasets to explain and expose potential opportunities from the data.
  • Develop data sets/schemas consuming data from multiple sources such as internal databases, analysis tools, unstructured sources, and other external sources.
  • Produce effective data narratives to drive action on these opportunities by designing and developing data visualizations using PowerBI.
  • Ensure the use of appropriate analytical methods to solve complex business problems.
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of complex data models, data structures, and best practices for data governance to support the data platform team in definitions and executions following best practices appropriate to use cases.
  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and analytical insights to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Degree in Information Systems, Data Science and Analytics, or related course.
  • Prior experience in technical management of Data Analyst teams. Extensive experience in data analysis, data science.
  • Advanced English is mandatory - will work with a global team. Other languages will be considered a differential.
  • Prior experience in cloud solutions such as Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or Teradata.
  • Expertise in database query and reporting tools (SQL + Power BI + DAX). Tableau & Mode will be considered a differential.
  • Effective skills in programming languages (Python, PySpark, SQL).
  • Experience in using SQL/NOSQL databases. "R" is considered a differential.
  • Strong skills in analysis, problem-solving, conceptual thinking, and a solid background in statistical analysis focused on data-driven solutions.
  • Experience in gathering complex business requirements and identifying data needs.
  • Experience in analyzing data to identify key insights, gaps, and inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with the Systems Development Life Cycle and Agile Methodology.
  • Experience in leveraging transactional and digital behavioral data to understand business impacts and user behavior as input for ROI.

Soft Skills:

  • Promote collaboration and a productive work environment by sharing knowledge and experience with direct subordinates.
  • Excellent leadership, team management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with multifunctional teams and present complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to seek unconventional solutions, explore opportunities, and develop innovative solutions.

description:
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a vertically integrated digital agency pioneering the next generation of consumer-facing brands. A category leader in results-driven growth marketing, Darkroom’s success is attributed to our unique partnership model, purposefully built to launch brands to market and accelerate growth across direct-to-consumer. Our model is predicated on three major partnership structures - Growth & Scaling, Digital Platforms, and Brand & Product Launches – threaded by one cohesive, interdisciplinary team.

Taking the startup mindset to the agency space, the collective expertise of our team of entrepreneurs and senior digital marketers are deeply aware of the newest trends in e-commerce, development, and digital marketing. Our learned experience has allowed us to take clients (and internal ventures) from $0 to millions in revenue in just a few months. We work with game-changing brands: Crate & Barrel, Popchips, FEED, Olipop, & CALPAK, to name a few.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Dark Arts service, that has been newly relaunched as the AI-powered creative direction service for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.

  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.

  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.

  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.

  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.

  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.

  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.

  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.

  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.

  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.

  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.

  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.

  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.

  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.

  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

What its like to work at Darkroom:

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Darkweek, Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, our annual “Darkweek” summer break, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.

  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024, we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled in your field, and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions, and adapt to ongoing changes. You are a true team player who 'chips in' when needed.

We are now looking for a Chief Engineer who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as a Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. The Chief Engineer is overall responsible for all technical installations onboard the vessel, including R&M and spare parts management, while ensuring costs are maintained at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals.
  • Overseeing the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Managing the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.
  • Collaborating with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.
  • Developing strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.
  • Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and promoting a safety culture within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from shipping or fishing companies, is structured and systematic yet flexible, and has a positive, can-do attitude. You are motivated to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

Qualifications:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1
  • Medical Certificate
  • Safety Course for officers
  • At least 5 years of experience as a Chief Engineer
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Proficient in project management software and tools
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

Location:

Vessel/Antarctica

Travel and rotation

Rotations are approximately 8 weeks on and off, with crew changes in Montevideo, Punta Arenas, and Puerto Williams. Deviations may occur due to operational needs.

Application and contact information

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity, please apply via the provided link. We will contact candidates on an ongoing basis. Send your application letter and CV in English or Norwegian to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for aquaculture, animal feed, and human health supplements. Our value chain includes vessels and sustainable krill harvesting in Antarctica, logistics in Montevideo, and global customers.

Our fleet includes four vessels, with operations year-round, except for maintenance in October. Offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with a logistics base in Montevideo. We are about 500 employees worldwide, with a diverse international team.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for aquaculture, enhancing growth and health. QRILL Pet benefits pet health with omega-3s proven to support various organs and functions.

Why join us?

Expect hard work, fun, and challenges. We support initiative and responsibility, aiming to be industry leaders and continually improve.

description:
Software at TRACTIAN
The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). This visionary approach empowers maintenance and process teams with a unified platform, enabling them to proactively predict equipment failures, optimize maintenance workflows, and enhance operational efficiency. In daily work the software department drives the convergence of cutting-edge technology and maintenance excellence to propel businesses toward unparalleled success.
What you'll do
As a Senior Backend Software Engineer at our company, you will be instrumental in shaping the foundation of our backend infrastructure. You'll play a critical role in building a scalable, resilient, and high-performing platform that supports our innovative product offerings and delivers an exceptional experience to our users.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a robust, scalable backend platform that integrates seamlessly with our frontend systems and aligns with business requirements.
  • Lead the development of reusable libraries and APIs that standardize backend functionality and simplify integration with other systems and services.

  • Proven problem-solving skills, leadership ability, and attention to detail.

Bonus points
